product_metadata.title: Lavish Home Folding Storage Bench Ottoman, 30" Tufted Foam Padded Lid, Beige, Light Gray
features: STORAGE BENCH – This ottoman bench features a lift-top lid with a spacious inside compartment, great for storing items. The bedroom bench makes a wonderful addition to any room while keeping your belongings organized.

VERSATILE USE – The bench with storage is great for use as a footstool, blanket storage, linen chest, end-of-bed storage, or entryway bench. The ottoman can be folded flat when not in use for convenient storage, making it perfect for small spaces.

STURDY COMFORT – The body of this ottoman storage is constructed from sturdy MDF materials, while the padded lid provides a comfortable place to put your feet up. This bedroom storage bench gives your home storage elegance and relaxation.

STYLISH DÉCOR – This comfortable ottoman with storage features a premium woven polyester outer cover, making it super easy to clean with a damp cloth. The modern, clean lines will bring chic function to your home with hidden storage.

PRODUCT DETAILS – Materials: Foam, Polyester, and MDF. Dimensions: (L) 30” x (W) 15” x (H) 15”; Removable Bin: (L) 13” x (W) 7” x (H) 4”; Folded: (L) 30” x (W) 15” x (H) 2.6”; Interior Weight Capacity: 50lbs. Color: Gray.
description: Bring the best of style and function to your home with the End of Bed Storage Bench by Lavish Home. This comfortable storage ottoman bench features a premium woven polyester outer cover with a highly resilient foam padded button-tufted cushioned lid. The collapsible design makes it easy to set up and can be folded flat when not in use for convenient storage, making it ideal for dorms, RVs, and small apartments. The small removable inner bin provides extra storage and organization options. This multipurpose large ottoman is great for use as a foot rest, end-of-bed storage, or entryway bench with storage, making a stylish addition to any bedroom, living room, entryway, or utility room while keeping your belongings organized.
